items.t: North Vancouver real estate market stats

faq.a: The District of North Vancouver, in the District's North Lonsdale–Delbrook planning area, alongside Delbrook, Norwood/Queens, Upper Delbrook and Carisbrooke.

École Braemar Elementary, 3600 Mahon Avenue, with English, Early French Immersion and Late French Immersion programs as described by SD44; Carson Graham Secondary, 2145 Jones Avenue, is south of the area, and the catchment for a specific address should be confirmed with SD44.

faq.q: What bus serves Delbrook Avenue and Mahon Avenue?
faq.a: Route 249 runs via Delbrook Avenue and West Queens Road between Montroyal Boulevard at Glencanyon Drive and Lonsdale Quay, connecting to the SeaBus.

faq.q: Can a Braemar house lot have a suite or a coach house?
faq.a: Yes. The District R2 zone in Zoning Bylaw 3210, Section 525 allows a principal dwelling plus a secondary suite in the principal building and a coach house, and since June 2024 three units total (principal, suite, coach house) are permitted on single-family lots within the Urban Containment Boundary.

faq.q: What is happening at the Delbrook Lands?
faq.a: At 600 West Queens Road, the District divided the former Delbrook Lands into a new neighbourhood park on the northern portion and a four-storey building with low-to-moderate-income rental housing and a seniors' care facility on the southern portion, under Bylaws 8397, 8398 and 8399 (2019).
